name: Water vapour (H2O, gas phase)
source: H2O molar mass 18.015 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (H 1.008 x2, O 15.999). H fraction 2.016/18.015 = 11.19067%.
notes: Same as water-liquid: identical molecule, different phase. Phase carries no conserved mass of its own, so the elemental composition is identical; only the state field differs. O closes the two-element compound exactly.
